effective permittivity using harmonic mean for parallel field.\n\n    For subpixel smoothing of dielectric interfaces, we use the standard\n    weighted harmonic/arithmetic mean pair for the two Permittivity of material a.\n    eps_b : float\n        Permittivity of material b.\n    f : float\n        Volume fraction of material b in the cell.\n\n    Returns\n    -------\n    float\n        Effective permittivity.\n    \"\"\"\n    if f <= 0.0:\n        return eps_a\n    if f >= 1.0:\n        return eps_b\n    # Harmonic mean for perpendicular polarization (1/eps = f/eps_b + Effective permittivity.\n    \"\"\"\n    if f <= 0.0:\n        return eps_a\n    if f >= 1.0:\n        return eps_b\n    # Harmonic mean for perpendicular polarization (1/eps = f/eps_b + \"\"\"\n    corners = [\n        (x_min, y_min, z_min),\n        (x_min, y_min, z_max),\n        (x_min, y_max, z_min),\n        (x_min, y_max, z_max),\n        (x_max, y_min, z_min),\n        (x_max, _effective_permittivity_isotropic(\n    eps_a: float,\n    eps_b: float,\n    f: float,\n) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Compute effective permittivity using harmonic mean for parallel field.\n\n    For _effective_permittivity_isotropic(\n    eps_a: float,\n    eps_b: float,\n    f: float,\n) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Compute effective permittivity using harmonic mean for parallel field.\n\n    For subpixel smoothing of dielectric interfaces, we use the standard\n    weighted harmonic/arithmetic mean pair for the two polarization cases.\n    This function returns the harmonic mean (for the case where E is\n    perpendicular to the interface normal).\n\n    Parameters\n    ----------\n    eps_a : float\n        Permittivity of material a.\n    eps_b : float\n        Permittivity of material b.\n    f : float\n        Volume fraction of material b in the cell.\n\n    Returns\n    -------\n    float\n        Effective permittivity.\n    \"\"\"\n    if f <= 0.0:\n        return eps_a\n return 1.0 / (f / eps_b_safe + (1.0 - f) / eps_a_safe)\n\n\ndef _effective_permeability_isotropic(\n    mu_a: float,\n    mu_b: float,\n    f: float,\n) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Compute effective permeability using harmonic mean for parallel field.\"\"\"\n    if f <= 0.0:\n        return mu_a\n    if f >= 1.0:\n        return mu_b\n    mu_a_safe = max(mu_a, 1e-20)\n    mu_b_safe = max(mu_b, 1e-20)\n    return 1.0 / (f / mu_b_safe + (1.0 - f) / mu_a_safe)\n\n\ndef _effective_medium_isotropic(\n    eps_a: float,\n    mu_a: float,\n    eps_b: float,\n    mu_b: float,\n    f: float,\n) -> _effective_permittivity_isotropic(\n    eps_a: float,\n    eps_b: float,\n    f: float,\n) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Compute effective permittivity using harmonic mean for parallel field.\n\n    For _effective_permittivity_isotropic(\n    eps_a: float,\n    eps_b: float,\n    f: float,\n) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Compute effective permittivity using harmonic mean for parallel field.\n\n    For return 1.0 / (f / eps_b_safe + (1.0 - f) / eps_a_safe)\n\n\ndef _effective_permeability_isotropic(\n    mu_a: float,\n    mu_b: float,\n    f: float,\n) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Compute effective 1e-20)\n    return 1.0 / (f / mu_b_safe + (1.0 - f) / mu_a_safe)\n\n\ndef _effective_medium_isotropic(\n    eps_a: float,\n    mu_a: float,\n    eps_b: float,\n    mu_b: float,\n    f: float,\n) ->
